name: Burj Khalifa
desc: The planet's tallest flex. The observation deck stings, but craning up from the fountain plaza is free and neck-cracking.

name: The Dubai Fountain
desc: Water doing choreography to opera under the Burj every evening. Front-row spectacle for exactly zero dirhams.

name: Dubai Frame
desc: A giant golden picture frame — old Dubai out one side, sci-fi Dubai out the other. Cheap ticket, expensive view.

name: Gold Souk
desc: Windows dripping with more gold than most central banks. Gawking is free; dreaming is actively encouraged.

name: Al Fahidi Historical District
desc: Wind towers, coral-stone walls and hushed lanes from before the skyscrapers. Old Dubai on a broke traveler's budget.

name: JBR Beach
desc: Free sand, warm Gulf water, a wall of towers glittering behind the towels. Swim first — the prices can wait.

name: Museum of the Future
desc: The torus building wrapped in glowing calligraphy. Steep entry, but even circling the outside feels like the year 2071.

name: Dubai Miracle Garden
desc: 150 million flowers sculpted into castles and airplanes, in a desert. Extra? Absolutely. Worth a someday? Also yes.

name: Abra Ride on Dubai Creek
desc: A wooden boat across the Creek for about thirty cents. The oldest commute in town and the best fare you'll ever pay.

name: Dubai Marina Walk
desc: Seven kilometers of yachts, towers and late-night shawarma. Strut it after dark like your ship already came in.
